title: Crying Cyber Mask Over City
description: A metallic cybernetic mask with glowing blue eyes and red lips floats in the upper center, golden tears streaming down its face. Below is a nighttime cityscape with a curving highway filled with cars, a large glowing sun on the horizon, and surreal floating flowers and a dripping hot dog connected by thin white lines against a dramatic red and orange sky.
prompt: Surreal digital painting of a metallic cybernetic android mask with glowing blue eyes and red lips floating in a black sky, golden tears dripping from its eyes, surrounded by glowing flowers and thin white energy lines connecting to a melting hot dog with dripping cheese and mustard. Below is a nighttime city skyline with a massive glowing orange sun setting behind it, a curving multi-lane highway with cars, dramatic red and orange clouds, in a dark cinematic style with high contrast.
